scope: Debug-only candidate routed through actual FriendConversationScreen and existing ImmersionBubble; default visible Reading options button retained until root-reviewed acceptance.

interactions.rest: No per-message ellipsis in candidate. Existing timestamp/delivery and inline slot remain; regular conversation header retained.
interactions.touch: Short tap on vocabulary keeps the existing flip action. Touch-and-hold on message text opens the existing contextual Reading options menu. No tap-to-menu competing with vocabulary.
interactions.selection: Select text is a menu action. It explicitly enters the existing native TextView selection handles/action mode. Selected text copy uses the visible face; Copy original message always uses the exact original sent text.
interactions.accessibility: Message actions is exposed on the actual native text node, with labeled long-click and custom action. Existing word actions/overflow chooser remain. Actual installed TalkBack service must execute message action; source inspection alone does not qualify.
interactions.keyboard: Focused message supports Menu key or Shift+F10; Back/Escape dismisses menu. Menu activation must restore or preserve useful focus without changing message text.
interactions.state: Menu/selection pauses automatic alternation; dismissal resumes with fresh dwell. No arrival/language/message identity changes may invoke an action on a different row. Full/script mode, unavailable state, report consent and original audio route remain current.
interactions.fallback: If touch/selection/TalkBack paths fail, candidate stays disabled and the current visible button remains default. No hidden inaccessible release state.

bounded_evidence: Actual production conversation with isolated synthetic peer/transport; no live backend mutation
At least three automatic phases with stable bounds, short word tap, native long-press menu
Explicit native Select text and selected-visible copy plus exact Copy original
Incoming Report opens existing explicit-consent sheet; no network submission
Full target and script toggles and native audio play/stop remain reachable
Actual TalkBack active, Message actions executes, word switching remains, automatic flipping paused
RTL/large text overflow menu reachable through native scrolling
nonclaims: No app-store release or production activation
